The grasp orientation is roll/pitch/yaw ≈ [2.6243, 1.5630, 2.6108]. I'll make a translation-only move toward the robot side of the drawer front, keeping that orientation, then check the effect.

{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [0.0, 0.66, 0.16, 2.6242588, 1.56297115, 2.61075388], "gripper": 0.0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}

The move stalled about 3.5 cm short of its target, and the measured gripper opening (0.27) differs from its closed command. I'll capture both views to see what is blocking it before moving again.

The topview shows the hand just in front of the green drawer front face, at about y≈0.67–0.68, with the arm stalled there. Pushing toward +y (closing) should press the drawer if this contact is on its face. I'll test a short push and check whether the drawer moves.
